title: Farewell to Heirloom Arts
contentHtml:
Beloved Heirloom Arts Theater in Danbury Connecticut has shut it’s doors for good moving all booked shows to a different venue. Heirloom Arts had a fantastic 8 year run with music fans and concert goers making it a venue that will be missed dearly. It surfaced on Facebook that Heirloom posted “Ladies and Gentlemen, it has been real and it has been fun” with links to a venue called The Space in Hamden CT where all of Heirloom Arts shows have been moved too. Heirloom Arts was many concert goers favorite venue for its intimacy and standing, it wasn’t the biggest venue but it also was not the smallest, making it one of the most popular venues in Connecticut for the metal genre. The Acacia Strain was there on November 6th with Fit For An Autopsy and Kublai Khan making one night for the records.
​Heirloom Arts always made a great impression on everyone and will be missed dearly.
Info on concerts that were moved to The Space in Hamden here: www.thespacect.com/
The Arc Booking Agency will honor any previously purchased tickets for Heirloom Arts on a moved show, contact them here: www.thearcagency.org/
